plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Agriculture - Agribusiness Emphasis (BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Agriculture & Agriculture Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Agribusiness (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. The catalog prints Total Credits, BS Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (15/15/15/15/16/14/16/14) and the plan to 120. The catalog prints the curriculum as ranges (Agriculture Core 36-37 credits; Agribusiness Emphasis 18-20 credits; curriculum 54-57 credits); the map exercises the catalog's options inside those ranges: the 4-credit chemistry pairing CHEM 1010 + CHEM 1015 (the catalog offers three lecture/lab pairings at 4-5 credits), COMM 4240 Technical Writing (one of the catalog's two writing options), and 7 credits of emphasis electives in the map's two elective rows (3 credits plus a 4-credit 'with Lab' row), inside the catalog's 6-8 credit elective block. Catalog titles are recorded where the map uses ampersands or shortens them ('Agriculture & Society', 'Intro to Chemistry', 'Business Law & Ethics', 'Feeding & Nutrition of Horses & Livestock', 'Management & Organizations'). Per the catalog, major requirements must be completed with a grade of 'C-' or better and courses completed over 10 years ago are not accepted toward this degree.
